# Haut CGI

> > Dubai-based CGI, VFX, and FOOH video production studio specializing in viral brand campaigns and product launches.

Haut CGI creates hyper-realistic computer-generated imagery and fake-out-of-home (FOOH) content for global brands across automotive, real estate, beauty, technology, and retail sectors. The studio combines cutting-edge visual effects with strategic marketing storytelling to produce viral-worthy campaigns for social media and traditional advertising channels.

## Key Topics

- FOOH (Fake Out of Home)
- CGI Video Production
- VFX Production
- Brand Activation Campaigns
- Product Launch Marketing
- Real Estate Marketing
- Automotive Marketing
- Seasonal Campaigns
- Social Media Content
- Viral Marketing
- 3D Visualization
- Brand Awareness
- Dubai Production Studio
- Beauty Tech Marketing
- Event Campaign Production
